label: preparing
what: Likely a surprise celebration in the great hall for my forty years as mayor, with bread provisioning and donated lanterns, timed around the eighteen-hundred inspection/committee meeting. The celebration's purpose is inferred, not explicitly disclosed. Builder is arranging the meeting and lights; Freight is coordinating provisions; innkeeper has obtained twenty-one loaves on personal credit. Secretary assists scheduling and provisioning enquiries, baker supplies bread, and neighbour may be helping keep me occupied with tea, though her knowing involvement is less certain.
